absent: Exact system register encodings and bit positions for timer control and compare beyond enable and mask and status roles
Definitions of timer access selectors and PPI number values and clock event feature flag values
Full side effects of clock event configuration and registration and per CPU interrupt enabling
Value of event stream base frequency and CPU hotplug state numbers and enable switch default
Implementations of counter low level accessors and cntkctl and event stream feature helpers
Semantics of vdso clock mode enumeration values beyond none and arch timer variants
Ownership and lifecycle of device tree and ACPI table arguments used for erratum matching
Behavior of suspend stop flag and compat vdso disable beyond mode selection shown

findings.text: The driver requires a minimum counter rollover horizon equivalent to forty years of seconds and derives a usable counter width from rate times that horizon, clamped to stay within fifty six and sixty four bits inclusive.

The system counter is presented under name arch_sys_counter with rating four hundred and continuous operation, while the per CPU event device uses name arch_sys_timer with rating four hundred fifty and oneshot capability plus optional low power stop support.

The five timer interrupt slots have fixed textual labels in secure physical and nonsecure physical and virtual and hypervisor physical and hypervisor virtual order corresponding to sec-phys and phys and virt and hyp-phys and hyp-virt.

A mask helper builds an all ones mask covering a given bit count from zero upward and a bit helper denotes a single bit by position, while the maximum event delta normally uses the full derived width except for a known broken compare implementation that falls back to thirty one bits.

Driver log messages carry a prefix built from arch_timer plus colon plus space and private interrupt trigger validation accepts only high or low level and otherwise warns and assumes low level, while a zero rate is rejected and rates below one megahertz emit a warning.

ACPI OEM matching uses a record holding a null terminated OEM identifier field sized for the standard identifier plus terminator and a null terminated table identifier field sized similarly plus a thirty two bit revision, with a list of HiSilicon platform entries terminated by an all zero sentinel.

Unstable counter handling centers on a global table of workaround descriptors keyed by match kind plus a per CPU pointer to the active workaround and an atomic flag recording whether any counter workaround is in use, alongside a per CPU event device area and a CPU mask tracking where event stream is available.

Module keeps timer rate and interrupt numbers and selected interrupt kind and low power flags in memory that becomes read only after early init, with virtual interrupt selected by default, plus a per CPU event area and a default userspace clock mode favoring arch timer and a CPU mask initially empty tracking stream availability and a cycle counter shim also fixed after init.

All upper layer counter reads go through a single indirect accessor defaulting to virtual count and vendor erratum variants repeat the underlying register read until samples satisfy a stability rule or a fixed retry budget expires and warn once on exhaustion, with budgets of two hundred and fifty and one hundred fifty depending on variant and rules covering exact equality and high bit difference and nine bit boundary avoidance.

Enabling a workaround that replaces virtual count reading disables fast userspace time entirely and a compat disable flag otherwise steps the default mode down to a no compat variant, while user access to virtual count is granted only when the local CPU lacks a virtual count workaround with trapping otherwise and other timer and counter accesses remaining disabled, and event stream configuration derives a power of two divider from half the timer rate clamped to maximum fifteen with special scaling gated by an extended counter capability that subtracts eight when a larger divider is needed.

Workaround lookup scans the global table for the requested match kind and applies a kind specific predicate, namely device tree boolean presence and current CPU capability test and exact match of OEM identifier plus table identifier plus revision against a sentinel terminated list.

Workaround activation chooses a matcher by kind and warns on unknown kinds and enables either locally on the current CPU or globally on all CPUs, and warns when a different workaround already occupies the slot and keeps the old one, while builds without workaround support turn all checks into no operation constants reporting absence.
Trigger type equals zero when no per interrupt data exists and otherwise equals state bits masked to trigger kind as resolved through layered helpers.

Stable physical and virtual counter reads run with preemption disabled around low level access while raw and direct variants expose the same underlying counts without that protection for constrained contexts, and workaround selection writes either the local CPU pointer or all possible CPU pointers with a single atomic indicator recording global use without additional locking shown.

Handled is reported only when status was asserted with the interrupt masked and the registered callback invoked, otherwise not handled is reported without side effects, while deadline programming guarantees enable is set and mask is cleared with compare equal to requested offset plus current count, and shutdown guarantees enable is cleared leaving other state untouched.

Per CPU bring up guarantees the event device is configured before its private interrupt is validated and enabled, with an optional extra nonsecure interrupt in secure configurations and user access fixed last and invalid interrupt selection treated as fatal, while event stream availability is present only between starting and dying notifications and stream registration is skipped when the event area or the enable switch is absent.

Execution enters through virtual and physical interrupt handlers receiving an event object and through per CPU start callbacks for timer and event stream plus an early boot parameter parser for the stream enable switch and an init time registration for stream hotplug steps.

The event device exposes separate shutdown and deadline programming entry points for virtual and physical access, with erratum aware deadline variants that use stabilized counter reads while preserving the same enable and unmask contract.
The module publishes an indirect counter accessor defaulting to virtual count and internal read shims for clocksource and cyclecounter that delegate to it.
Erratum infrastructure exposes a generic deadline programmer plus enable and predicate helpers and a per CPU pointer to the active workaround for use across translation units.

Counter silicon may return torn or stuck samples so drivers must use bounded reread loops and treat budget exhaustion as a warning condition, and enabling a second conflicting workaround only warns and keeps the first, while a broken compare implementation restricts range to thirty one bits and firmware may supply an invalid interrupt trigger which is forced to low level with warnings.

Using an out of line virtual count accessor must disable fast userspace time to avoid inconsistent reads and trapping of user virtual count access is required on affected CPUs, while stop in low power flags alter event device capabilities and secure configurations may require enabling an extra nonsecure interrupt.
